why_agent_cannot: a wallet connection or signature is required
what_human_must_do: Check that you can get in. "Season 4 is open to active traders from previous Fairground seasons, along with new traders who receive a referral invitation." Trading in an earlier season counts if you held or filled at least one order.

New traders: register through a referral link from an eligible trader. "If selected, they will receive an email from [email protected] with access instructions." You give an email address and a wallet address; wallet age may be checked.
Open app.fairground.fi and connect that wallet, or sign in with email, Google, X, Telegram or Discord to get a wallet made for you. Your own wallet needs Arbitrum Sepolia, chain ID 421614.
Trade with the testnet USDC Fairground sends you: "Eligible participants are allocated 2,000 Testnet USDC each day at 16:00 UTC." Gas comes free too. Orders only count once they fill.
costs: It costs nothing. "No. Participation uses Fairground Testnet USDC tokens, not real funds." The testnet USDC can't be withdrawn or sold, and the trading fees and rebates in the app are paid in it too. What you do give is an email address, a wallet address and, optionally, your social handles. Fairground says: "User data is retained for up to 12 months in accordance with security and compliance requ
risks: Excluded are people in sanctioned places, "including without limitation Iran, North Korea, Cuba, Syria, the Crimea, Donetsk, or Luhansk regions", and China. You must be of legal age, 18 in the US. There's no KYC. Being invited isn't enough on its own: "Participation in the Program is subject to approval and ongoing eligibility requirements determined by Forte Foundation in its sole discretion." XP
